name: Heterogeneous block-diagonal generator-separation upper construction
abstraction: For t>=1 complement components with disjoint cell grounds and pairwise disjoint row and column projections, pad and union same-index local pairs, then add binary whole-component separators to obtain sigma(G)<=max_r k_r+ceil(log2 t).
preconditions: component complement cell grounds are disjoint
component row projections are pairwise disjoint and component column projections are pairwise disjoint
each component local family is explicitly disjoint and generator-separating
empty endpoint fibres are handled under the source definition
operation: prove the component decomposition, validate every local family, multiplex pair indices across components, and add binary whole-component partitions
guaranteed_effects: under the stated preconditions, gives an explicit full-cover upper bound max local size plus logarithmic component separation
non_guarantees: does not give a lower bound or exact full-cover value
does not apply after cross-component complement coupling changes endpoint fibres
does not imply later decoder levels remain decomposable
one retrospective application does not promote universal method authority
validation_obligations: prove the full complement decomposition rather than infer it from samples
check all local generator fibres and pair disjointness
check all cross-component active edge orientations
proof_backing: C044 heterogeneous block multiplexing hand proof
